3.2. Counting direction-consistent circuits: generalized BEST theorem.
The well-known BEST theorem, named after de Bruijn and van Aardenne-Ehrenfest [vAEdB51]
and Smith and Tutte [TS41], provides an eﬃcient algorithm of counting Eulerian
cycles on an Eulerian digraph Go (meaning that the in-degree and out-degree at
each vertex of Go are identical).
Recall that an arborescence T of Go with a root vertex w is a spanning tree of G
such that all edges on T are oriented towards w with respect to o. Recall also that
